summary: Comprehensive testing of NEW date filtering feature in FirmaFinder CRM - all backend tests passed (9/9), all frontend features working correctly
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/search/caen/1812?county=40 returns 243 companies with establishment_date from ANAF API
Backend: GET /api/search?q=TIPAR&county=40 returns companies with establishment_date from ANAF
Backend: ANAF enrichment provides phone numbers for many companies
Backend: GET /api/caen-codes returns exactly 9 printing CAEN codes
Backend: POST /api/auth/login works with admin credentials
Backend: POST /api/companies saves company with establishment_date, phone, j_number from ANAF data
Frontend: Login page works with admin@firmafinder.com / Admin123!
Frontend: Search page loads with date filter input (data-testid='since-date')
Frontend: CAEN dropdown shows 9 codes and selection works
Frontend: Date filter input sends since_date parameter to API
Frontend: Search results show 'EST. DATE' column with establishment dates
Frontend: Results info shows '(established since 2025-01-01)' when filter applied
Frontend: Save button saves company with establishment_date, phone, j_number
Frontend: 'Lead saved!' toast notification appears after saving
seed_data_creation: Admin account seeded on startup via ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars
context_for_next_testing_agent: Date filtering feature fully working. CAEN search with since_date=2025-01-01 returns ~18 companies, since_date=2020-01-01 returns ~50 companies, no filter returns ~243 companies. ANAF API enrichment provides establishment_date (data_inregistrare), phone, j_number, address. API calls can take 5-30 seconds due to ANAF batch processing. Use role='option' for Radix Select items in Playwright tests.

mocked_apis.note: All data comes from LIVE mfinante.gov.ro scraping + LIVE ANAF API enrichment. No mocked APIs.

date_filtering.details: since_date parameter correctly filters companies by establishment_date >= filter date
